compute_3d_box_iou: compute the intersection over union and volume of two sets of 3D boxes defined by their 8 corners
check_coplanar_box_faces: check that the vertices on each face of a 3D box tensor are coplanar within a tolerance
check_nonzero_box_faces: check that all triangular faces of a 3D box tensor have non-zero area
run_box3d_overlap_forward: run the forward pass of the box3d_overlap autograd function to compute volume and IoU via the C++ extension
review_box3d_overlap_class: review the _box3d_overlap autograd Function wrapper class and its unsupported backward pass implementation
